prompt:
You are an experienced internal-controls practitioner building a TEST SET for evaluating an automated
Risk & Control Matrix (RCM) reviewer. You write realistic controls AND label their design defects.

Company: invent ONE fictional Swiss company (not a real one, not "Alpenfirn", "Limmatquell", and not a private hospital), in an industry other than
industrial manufacturing (e.g. medtech, food, logistics, retail, insurance broker, energy utility). Currency CHF. Give it a name ending in AG.

Write exactly 30 controls:
- Processes: Procure-to-Pay, Order-to-Cash, Treasury, Record-to-Report, ITGC, and HR/Payroll (spread them).
- Exactly 10 controls written in GERMAN (Swiss Standard German: "ss" instead of "ß"), using Swiss IKS terminology
  (e.g. IKS, Kontrollverantwortliche/r, Visum, Vier-Augen-Prinzip, Kollektivunterschrift zu zweien,
  Monatsabschluss, Kreditoren/Debitoren, Zahlungsfreigabe, Schlüsselkontrolle). In German controls, ALL text fields
  (process names may stay English) are in German, including owner, frequency, type, nature and evidence values.
  The other 20 controls are in English. Mix the languages across processes.
  ORDER: controls 1 to 10 of the array are the German ones (language "de"); controls 11 to 30 are English
  (language "en"). Exactly 10 "de", not 9, not 11.
- At least 10 controls must be CLEAN: a well-designed control with no defect at all.
- The rest have realistic defects, 1–4 each. Across the set, every defect type below must appear at least twice.
- Write the way real RCMs are written: some precise, some sloppy, some passive voice. Vary length.
- Use IDs like P2P-H01, O2C-H02, TRE-H03, R2R-H04, ITG-H05, HRP-H06 (unique).

Defect types (label EVERY one that applies to a control, not only the one you intended; labels must be exhaustive):
- who: the description does not name the performer as an accountable role (passive voice with no actor, a department
  like "Finance", a team, or a person's name). A system performing an automated control is fine.
- what: the action is vague or not testable ("ensures", "monitors", "looks at", "oversees") instead of a concrete
  action (review, reconcile, compare, approve, block, match).
- when: no timing or trigger is stated (e.g. "within 3 business days after month-end", "before release", "at posting").
- frequency: how often it runs is missing from both description and frequency column, or is implausible for the risk.
- evidence: the description does not say what evidence is retained and where.
- precision: a review / detective / approval control has no threshold or investigation criterion ("significant",
  "unusual" or nothing). Not applicable to purely automated preventive controls.
- freq_mismatch: a frequency word in the description contradicts the frequency column.
- nature_mismatch: nature column says automated, but the description describes manual steps.
- owner_invalid: the control_owner column is empty, a department/placeholder, or a person's name instead of a role.
- sod_conflict: the same role both performs and approves/reviews the same activity.
- missing_risk_link: risk_id is empty or control_objective is empty.
- key_no_evidence: key_control is true but the evidence column is empty.

Return JSON only:
{"company": {"name": string, "industry": string, "description": string},
 "controls": [{"control_id": string, "language": "en"|"de", "process": string, "sub_process": string,
   "risk_id": string, "risk_description": string, "control_objective": string, "control_description": string,
   "control_owner": string, "frequency": string, "control_type": string, "nature": string, "key_control": boolean,
   "evidence": string, "systems": string, "assertions": string,
   "defects": [one or more of "who", "what", "when", "frequency", "evidence", "precision", "freq_mismatch", "nature_mismatch", "owner_invalid", "sod_conflict", "missing_risk_link", "key_no_evidence"] or [],
   "defect_notes": string}]}

company.name: HelvetiaMedTech AG
company.description: Mid-sized Swiss developer and distributor of orthopedic implants and diagnostic instruments headquartered in Zug, operating in CHF under Swiss OR and ISO 13485.

controls.risk_description: Unautorisierte oder fiktive Kreditoren werden im System angelegt, was zu betrügerischen Zahlungen führen kann.
controls.control_objective: Sicherstellen, dass alle neuen oder geänderten Kreditorenstammdaten gültig und nach dem Vier-Augen-Prinzip genehmigt sind.
controls.control_description: Vor der Freigabe eines neuen oder geänderten Kreditors mit geänderter IBAN in SAP S/4HANA prüft der Leiter Kreditorenbuchhaltung (Kontrollverantwortlicher) täglich die Änderungsmeldung gegen das Handelsregister sowie die Bankbestätigung auf 100% Übereinstimmung. Bei Abweichungen wird der Kreditor gesperrt. Die Freigabe wird mittels elektronischem Visum im SAP-Workflow dokumentiert und zusammen mit den Prüfbelegen im SAP-Archiv abgelegt.
controls.evidence: Elektronisches Visum im SAP-Workflow und archivierte Bankbestätigung in SAP
controls.defect_notes: Clean control in Swiss Standard German with clear role, trigger, action, precision (100% match), and archived evidence.

controls.risk_description: Lieferungen erfolgen an zahlungsunfähige Debitoren, was zu Forderungsausfällen führt.
controls.control_objective: Verhindern von Lieferungen an Kunden, die ihr Kreditlimit überschreiten.
controls.control_description: Bei der Erfassung eines Kundenauftrags prüft SAP S/4HANA automatisch, ob der Auftragswert zusammen mit dem offenen Debitorensaldo das hinterlegte Kreditlimit um mehr als CHF 0 überschreitet. Bei einer Überschreitung blockiert das System den Auftrag automatisch für die Auslieferung (Liefersperre) und protokolliert die Sperre im System-Log von SAP.
controls.evidence: SAP-Systemkonfiguration und automatisches Sperrprotokoll in SAP S/4HANA
controls.defect_notes: Clean automated preventive control in Swiss German.

controls.risk_description: Unautorisierte oder fehlerhafte Auszahlungen werden über das E-Banking freigegeben.
controls.control_objective: Sicherstellen, dass sämtliche Bankzahlungen durch zwei zeichnungsberechtigte Personen freigegeben werden.
controls.control_description: Vor der Übermittlung eines Zahlungslaufs an die Bank prüfen der Leiter Treasury und der CFO im Rahmen der Kollektivunterschrift zu zweien (Vier-Augen-Prinzip) jeden Zahlungslauf im UBS E-Banking. Einzelzahlungen über CHF 50'000 werden zusätzlich gegen die freigegebene Rechnung in SAP abgeglichen. Unstimmige Posten werden vor der Zahlungsfreigabe aus dem Lauf entfernt. Die digitale Signatur beider Freigeber wird im E-Banking-Audit-Log gespeichert.
controls.evidence: Digitale Signaturen (Kollektivunterschrift) im UBS E-Banking Audit-Log
controls.defect_notes: Clean manual preventive control in Swiss German.

controls.risk_description: Differenzen zwischen Nebenbuch und Hauptbuch bleiben unentdeckt und führen zu falschen Finanzberichten.
controls.control_objective: Vollständige und korrekte Überleitung der Kreditoren- und Debitoren-Nebenbücher ins Hauptbuch beim Monatsabschluss.
controls.control_description: Bis zum 3. Arbeitstag nach Monatsende führt der Hauptbuchhalter eine Abstimmung zwischen den Salden der Kreditoren- und Debitoren-Nebenbücher und den entsprechenden Hauptbuch-Abstimmkonten in SAP durch. Jede Differenz grösser als CHF 100 wird untersucht und vor Abschluss der Buchungsperiode bereinigt. Die Abstimmung wird vom Leiter Rechnungswesen geprüft, mit digitalem Visum versehen und im IKS-Ordner auf SharePoint abgelegt.
controls.evidence: Signierte Abstimmungsdatei mit Visum im IKS-SharePoint-Ordner
controls.defect_notes: Clean detective control in Swiss German.

controls.risk_description: Rechnungen werden ohne gültige Bestellung oder für nicht gelieferte Waren bezahlt.
controls.control_objective: Sicherstellen, dass nur geprüfte und korrekte Kreditorenrechnungen bezahlt werden.
controls.control_description: Die Finanzabteilung überwacht die offenen Kreditorenrechnungen und stellt sicher, dass grössere Abweichungen geklärt werden.
controls.defect_notes: Department named instead of role (who, owner_invalid); vague 'überwacht/stellt sicher' (what); no timing/trigger (when); no frequency in text or column (frequency); no threshold beyond 'grössere' (precision); no evidence stated in text (evidence) and empty evidence column on a key control (key_no_evidence).

controls.risk_description: Unberechtigte Rabatte oder falsche Listenpreise reduzieren die Bruttomarge.
controls.control_objective: Sicherstellen, dass Preisänderungen im System korrekt und genehmigt sind.
controls.control_description: Am Ende jedes Quartals prüft Herr Markus Keller das Preisänderungsprotokoll in SAP auf ungewöhnliche Rabatte und gibt die Liste per E-Mail frei, welche im Laufwerk G: gespeichert wird.
controls.evidence: Freigabe-E-Mail und Prüfprotokoll auf Laufwerk G:
controls.defect_notes: Person's name used instead of role in both description (who) and owner column (owner_invalid); 'ungewöhnliche Rabatte' lacks concrete threshold (precision); quarterly in description contradicts monthly in frequency column (freq_mismatch).

controls.risk_description: Nicht verbuchte Banktransaktionen oder unautorisierte Belastungen bleiben unbemerkt.
controls.control_objective: Vollständige und zeitnahe Erfassung aller Bankbewegungen im Hauptbuch.
controls.control_description: Innerhalb von zwei Arbeitstagen nach Wochenschluss druckt der Sachbearbeiter Treasury die Kontoauszüge der Zürcher Kantonalbank aus, gleicht jede Position manuell mit dem SAP-Bankkonto ab, klärt sämtliche Differenzen über CHF 0 und legt das visierte Abstimmblatt im physischen Bundesordner im Büro ab.
controls.evidence: Visiertes Abstimmblatt im physischen Bundesordner
controls.defect_notes: Nature column says 'Automatisiert' (automated), but the control description describes a purely manual paper reconciliation.

controls.risk_description: Fehlerhafte oder betrügerische manuelle Buchungen im Hauptbuch verfälschen den Jahresabschluss.
controls.control_description: Vor dem endgültigen Buchen im Hauptbuch erfasst der Bilanzbuchhalter manuelle Journalbuchungen über CHF 10'000 in SAP und gibt diese eigenen Buchungen anschliessend selbst im System frei. Der Buchungsbeleg samt Freigabevermerk wird in SAP archiviert.
controls.evidence: Archivierter Buchungsbeleg mit Freigabevermerk in SAP
controls.defect_notes: Same role (Bilanzbuchhalter) posts and approves their own manual journal entries violating Vier-Augen-Prinzip (sod_conflict); risk_id and control_objective are empty (missing_risk_link).

controls.risk_description: Mitarbeitende behalten nach Abteilungswechsel oder Austritt unberechtigte Zugriffsrechte in produktiven Systemen.
controls.control_objective: Sicherstellen, dass Benutzerberechtigungen in SAP den aktuellen Funktionen entsprechen.
controls.control_description: Die SAP-Berechtigungslisten werden regelmässig durchgesehen und auffällige Berechtigungen werden bei Bedarf angepasst.
controls.defect_notes: Passive voice with no actor (who); 'durchgesehen' is vague (what); 'regelmässig/bei Bedarf' gives no concrete timing trigger (when); 'auffällige Berechtigungen' lacks clear review criteria (precision); no evidence mentioned in text (evidence) and evidence column is empty for a key control (key_no_evidence).

controls.risk_description: Fehlerhafte Lohnberechnungen oder fiktive Mitarbeitende führen zu unberechtigten Lohnzahlungen.
controls.control_objective: Sicherstellen, dass die monatliche Lohnabrechnung vollständig, rechnerisch korrekt und vor Auszahlung genehmigt ist.
controls.control_description: Spätestens am 22. jedes Monats vor der Zahlungsfreigabe im E-Banking prüft die Leiterin HR das Lohnjournal sowie das Differenzprotokoll zum Vormonat in Abacus. Jede Abweichung des Bruttolohns von mehr als CHF 500 pro Mitarbeitendem sowie sämtliche Ein- und Austritte werden anhand der unterzeichneten Arbeitsverträge und Mutationsformulare verifiziert. Nach Klärung aller Abweichungen visiert die Leiterin HR das Lohnjournal elektronisch in Abacus, wo es revisionssicher archiviert wird.
controls.evidence: Elektronisch visiertes Lohnjournal und Differenzprotokoll im Abacus-Archiv
controls.defect_notes: Clean control in Swiss German.

controls.risk_description: Supplier invoices are paid for incorrect quantities or unauthorized prices.
controls.control_objective: Ensure supplier invoices match approved purchase orders and goods receipts before payment.
controls.control_description: Upon invoice posting, SAP S/4HANA automatically performs a three-way match between the supplier invoice, the approved purchase order, and the goods receipt. If the price variance exceeds 2% or CHF 200 (whichever is lower), or if experience shows any quantity variance above 0 units, SAP automatically blocks the invoice for payment until resolved and approved by the Head of Procurement.
controls.evidence: SAP three-way match tolerance configuration and automated payment block log in SAP S/4HANA
controls.defect_notes: Clean automated preventive control.

controls.risk_description: Revenue is recognized in the wrong accounting period for goods shipped around month-end.
controls.control_objective: Ensure revenue is recorded in the correct period based on INCOTERMS delivery dates.
controls.control_description: Within 2 business days after month-end, the Revenue Accountant compares all dispatches above CHF 5,000 recorded in the Warehouse Management System during the last 3 days of the closing month and the first 3 days of the new month against the courier proof-of-delivery and the invoice posting date in SAP. Any shipment where risk had not transferred before midnight on the balance sheet date is reversed or accrued. The signed cut-off reconciliation worksheet is reviewed by the Corporate Controller and saved in the Month-End Close folder on SharePoint.
controls.evidence: Signed cut-off reconciliation worksheet saved on SharePoint
controls.defect_notes: Clean detective control.

controls.risk_description: Speculative or unauthorized foreign exchange derivative contracts expose the company to financial loss.
controls.control_objective: Ensure all FX forward contracts comply with the Board-approved Treasury Policy and hedging ratios.
controls.control_description: Every Friday by 16:00, the Treasury Manager reconciles all open FX forward contracts in 360T and SAP Treasury against the rolling 12-month EUR and USD cash-flow exposure forecast. Any hedge ratio exceeding 80% of forecasted net exposure or any single trade above CHF 1,000,000 without prior CFO approval is escalated immediately to the CFO for remediation. The reconciliation report is digitally signed by the CFO in DocuSign and archived in the Treasury SharePoint repository.
controls.evidence: DocuSign-signed FX exposure reconciliation report in Treasury SharePoint
controls.defect_notes: Clean detective control.

controls.risk_description: Expired or slow-moving medical device inventory is carried at above net realizable value.
controls.control_objective: Ensure inventory obsolescence reserves are accurately calculated and recorded at quarter-end.
controls.control_description: By business day 4 of each quarter-end close, the Cost Accounting Manager generates the SAP Inventory Aging and Shelf-Life Report and recalculates the obsolescence provision: 50% reserve for items with remaining sterile shelf-life under 6 months or zero movement in 180 days, and 100% reserve for expired items or items with zero movement in 360 days. Variances greater than CHF 2,500 against the general ledger reserve account are adjusted via journal entry. The Head of Controlling reviews and approves the calculation workbook via ServiceNow Close Management, where the workbook and approval timestamp are stored.
controls.evidence: Approved obsolescence workbook and approval log in ServiceNow Close Management
controls.defect_notes: Clean detective control.

controls.risk_description: Unauthorized or untested transports moved into SAP production cause system outages or data corruption.
controls.control_objective: Ensure all configuration and code changes are tested and approved before migration to production.
controls.control_description: Prior to importing any transport request into the SAP S/4HANA Production environment, SAP Solution Manager (ChaRM) enforces a mandatory workflow requiring documented user acceptance test sign-off by the Business Process Owner and technical release approval by the IT Release Manager (who cannot be the developer of the transport). Transports lacking both approvals are automatically blocked from import by ChaRM, and all workflow approvals are permanently logged in SAP Solution Manager.
controls.evidence: ChaRM workflow configuration and transport approval logs in SAP Solution Manager
controls.defect_notes: Clean automated ITGC control.

controls.risk_description: Terminated employees continue to receive salary payments or retain system access after their exit date.
controls.control_objective: Ensure all leavers are promptly deactivated in payroll and IT systems upon termination.
controls.control_description: Within 24 hours of an employee's contractual exit date, the HR Operations Specialist reconciles the monthly Termination Report from Workday against active payroll records in Abacus and active user accounts in Active Directory. Any active account or open payroll record with a discrepancy of 1 or more days past the termination date is immediately deactivated. The completed offboarding checklist and reconciliation sign-off are archived in the closed ticket in ServiceNow.
controls.evidence: Completed offboarding checklist and reconciliation ticket in ServiceNow
controls.defect_notes: Clean detective control.

controls.risk_description: Unauthorized purchases are committed without budget availability.
controls.control_objective: Ensure purchase requisitions are reviewed for budget alignment before PO creation.
controls.control_description: Procurement looks at open purchase requisitions and ensures that spending is reasonable.
controls.evidence: None
controls.defect_notes: Team named instead of role (who, owner_invalid); 'looks at / ensures' is vague (what); no timing or trigger (when); no frequency in text or column (frequency); 'reasonable' lacks criteria/threshold (precision); no evidence described in text (evidence).

controls.risk_description: Old uninvoiced goods receipts (GR/IR) accumulate, distorting accrued liabilities.
controls.control_objective: Ensure aged GR/IR balances are investigated and cleared timely.
controls.control_description: On the 5th business day of every month, the AP Accountant downloads the GR/IR aging report from SAP, manually investigates all open items older than 60 days exceeding CHF 500 by contacting buyers and suppliers, posts clearing entries, and saves the signed reconciliation file in SharePoint.
controls.evidence: Signed GR/IR reconciliation workbook on SharePoint
controls.defect_notes: Nature column states 'Automated', whereas the control is clearly manual/IT-dependent manual.

controls.risk_description: Buyers issue fraudulent purchase orders to favored vendors.
controls.control_objective: Ensure segregation of duties between purchase order creation and approval.
controls.control_description: Before a purchase order above CHF 25,000 is transmitted to the vendor, the Senior Buyer who created the purchase order in SAP reviews the pricing against the framework contract and releases the purchase order in the SAP workflow. The approval timestamp is stored in SAP.
controls.evidence: SAP PO release history log
controls.defect_notes: The Senior Buyer both creates and approves/releases their own purchase order above CHF 25,000.

controls.risk_description: Unauthorized credit notes are issued to conceal misappropriation of cash or inflate sales returns.
controls.control_objective: Ensure credit notes are valid and approved prior to posting.
controls.control_description: Credit memos issued to customers are reviewed for unusual amounts and approved.
controls.defect_notes: Passive voice with no role in text (who) and department in owner column (owner_invalid); no timing/trigger stated (when); 'unusual amounts' has no threshold (precision); no evidence in description (evidence) and empty evidence column on a key control (key_no_evidence).

controls.risk_description: Overdue accounts receivable are not adequately provided for, overstating net receivables.
controls.control_description: On business day 3 of every month, the Credit Controller reconciles the SAP AR Aging report against the bad debt allowance policy (50% for invoices >90 days overdue, 100% for invoices >180 days overdue or in bankruptcy), investigates variances above CHF 1,000, and submits the bad debt schedule to the Head of Accounting for electronic sign-off in BlackLine.
controls.evidence: Electronically signed bad debt schedule in BlackLine
controls.defect_notes: Description says 'every month' while frequency column says 'Quarterly' (freq_mismatch); risk_id and control_objective are empty (missing_risk_link).

controls.risk_description: Insufficient liquidity on operating bank accounts leads to payment defaults or costly overdraft fees.
controls.control_objective: Ensure daily CHF, EUR, and USD bank balances are sufficient to cover upcoming disbursements.
controls.control_description: Once every three years, the Treasury Analyst compares the daily bank cash balances in ZKB and UBS against scheduled AP and payroll payment runs for the week and initiates intercompany sweeps if any account balance drops below CHF 100,000. The signed daily cash sheet is archived in SharePoint.
controls.evidence: Signed cash position worksheet in SharePoint
controls.defect_notes: Frequency ('Every 3 years') is completely implausible for monitoring daily bank liquidity against weekly payment runs.

controls.risk_description: Former employees remain on bank signatory lists and can execute unauthorized banking transactions.
controls.control_objective: Ensure bank authorized signatory lists match current employment and Board resolution records.
controls.control_description: Sandra Meier oversees the bank signatory lists and makes sure they are up to date with the Commercial Register of Canton Zug.
controls.defect_notes: Person's name used instead of role in text (who) and owner column (owner_invalid); 'oversees / makes sure' is vague and untestable (what); no timing trigger stated in text (when); no criterion for discrepancy handling (precision); no evidence mentioned in text (evidence) and empty evidence column on a key control (key_no_evidence).

controls.risk_description: Repair and maintenance expenses are improperly capitalized as fixed assets.
controls.control_objective: Ensure only qualifying capital expenditures above CHF 5,000 are capitalized in the fixed asset sub-ledger.
controls.control_description: Within 3 business days of month-end, the Fixed Asset Accountant reviews the SAP Capitalization Report for all asset additions posted during the month and compares each addition against the invoice and approved CapEx Request Form to verify that the item exceeds the CHF 5,000 capitalization threshold and provides future economic benefit. Any misclassified expense is reclassified to OPEX before period close. The reviewed report is signed off in BlackLine.
controls.evidence: Signed-off Capitalization Report in BlackLine
controls.defect_notes: Description states 'Within 3 business days of month-end / posted during the month' (monthly), which contradicts 'Annually' in the frequency column.

controls.risk_description: Unreconciled intercompany balances lead to consolidation elimination errors.
controls.control_objective: Ensure all intercompany receivables and payables between HelvetiaMedTech AG and its distribution subsidiaries are reconciled at month-end.
controls.control_description: By business day 4 after month-end, the Consolidation Manager reconciles intercompany AR and AP balances in SAP and investigates material differences.
controls.evidence: Intercompany matrix stored in SAP
controls.defect_notes: Description does not state what evidence is retained or where (evidence); 'material differences' lacks a specific CHF threshold (precision).

controls.risk_description: Direct federal and cantonal tax accruals in Zug are miscalculated.
controls.control_objective: Ensure accurate calculation of annual and interim income tax provisions.
controls.control_description: Before finalizing the year-end financial statements on business day 8 of January, the Head of Tax prepares the Swiss federal and Zug cantonal tax provision calculation in Excel, reconciles taxable income to pre-tax book income in SAP to within CHF 500, and approves their own tax calculation worksheet before booking the accrual in SAP. The signed Excel calculation is archived in BlackLine.
controls.evidence: Signed tax calculation worksheet archived in BlackLine
controls.defect_notes: Head of Tax both prepares and approves their own tax calculation and accrual (sod_conflict); risk_id is empty (missing_risk_link).

controls.risk_description: Failed nightly interface batch jobs between Warehouse Management and SAP S/4HANA result in incomplete financial data.
controls.control_objective: Ensure failed nightly interface jobs are detected and resolved promptly.
controls.control_description: IT Operations monitors batch jobs and makes sure interfaces run smoothly.
controls.defect_notes: Team named in description (who) and empty control_owner column (owner_invalid); 'monitors / makes sure' is vague (what); no timing stated (when); no frequency in text or column (frequency); no criteria for failure resolution (precision); no evidence in text (evidence) and empty evidence column on a key control (key_no_evidence).

controls.risk_description: Database backups are corrupted and cannot be restored in the event of ransomware or hardware failure.
controls.control_objective: Ensure SAP production database backups can be completely and accurately restored.
controls.control_description: On the last Saturday of each quarter, the Database Administrator performs a full test restoration of the encrypted SAP HANA production backup onto an isolated sandbox server, verifies 100% database consistency via HANA DBCC checks with zero unrecoverable blocks, and uploads the restoration log and test completion certificate to ServiceNow.
controls.evidence: Restoration log and test completion certificate in ServiceNow
controls.defect_notes: Nature column says 'Automated', but the control describes a manual quarterly test restoration performed by the DBA.

controls.risk_description: Sales commissions are overpaid due to inaccurate sales achievement calculations.
controls.control_objective: Ensure annual sales commission payouts match audited revenue figures and approved commission plans.
controls.control_description: Prior to the March payroll run, the Compensation & Benefits Manager reconciles each sales representative's commission calculation against audited net revenue per customer in SAP and the signed target agreement. Any variance exceeding CHF 50 is corrected before upload to Abacus. The Head of HR and CFO digitally sign the final commission payout table in DocuSign, which is archived in Workday.
controls.evidence: DocuSign-signed commission payout table archived in Workday
controls.defect_notes: Clean preventive control.

controls.risk_description: Unauthorized changes to employee base salaries or bank accounts in Abacus lead to payroll fraud.
controls.control_objective: Ensure all changes to payroll master data are independently verified against signed HR documentation.
controls.control_description: Before the monthly payroll lock on the 20th of each month, the Payroll Specialist prints the Abacus Master Data Change Log and compares changes against HR files.
controls.evidence: Signed master data change log in HR binder
controls.defect_notes: Description omits what evidence is retained and where (evidence); no threshold/criterion for checking 100% of changes vs a threshold and how exceptions are handled (precision); Payroll Specialist reviews the master data change log of the system they maintain without independent review (sod_conflict).
